purpose: Test-only public source snapshots for an isolated Binance chart-storage prototype; never include in install artifacts.

extraction.method: Parse the main bundle AST. Select the unique numeric Property 43917 from the first webpack chunk push module map. Copy the complete original property range into a two-element registration-only chunk payload. Preserve the original method factory and its inline license without formatting. No application entrypoint or runtime callback is retained.
extraction.ranges: Zero-based UTF-16 string offsets; end is exclusive.

dependencies.notes: The factory reads webpack require.g for the global object. Its bundled Browserify loader contains an unexecuted external require fallback for missing internal modules; it is not an external webpack module import. Evaluate the factory only through the real runtime in an isolated test context.

verification.runtime_startup: Installs the webpack-compatible chunk registration and loader helpers. With an empty chunk queue, it neither requires a business module nor starts a chunk load. An existing queue can contain runtime callbacks that it will execute; use a new isolated context.
